fusions.name: Sow to Gorge
fusions.desc: Cuts every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 9 blood damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Shared Carving
fusions.desc: Cuts the target for 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Glean the Fallen
fusions.desc: Gleans every body within 6 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Appetite From the Field
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, the healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
